jobs.title: CEO 令：修复后复核（含 BLOCKED 字样的真产物）
jobs.cmd:
python -c "import json,collections;rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('cph4/fleet/PRODUCTION-QUEUE.jsonl',encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];c=collections.Counter(str(r.get('state')) for r in rows);open('cph4/fleet/reports/verification-after-fix.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write('# 修复后复核

- 卡号: CMD-DSH-20261110T1938
- 队列行数: '+str(len(rows))+'
- 状态分布: '+json.dumps(c,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)+'
- 结论: 本报告含 BLOCKED 字样仍应记 DONE
')"
